actions.item: Functional real five-batch artifact executor for five hourly business lanes
actions.before: Central worker could validate already existing Git commits but could not write any authorized source file and had no batch checkpoint/resume pathway
actions.change: Implemented checked-out-branch source authoring from explicit job contents, five 10-action commits, one immutable receipt manifest, central handoff, exclusive process lock and proof-checked resume after interruption
actions.after: Source committed; 45 central QA tests passed including 50 real synthetic file mutations and interruption after item 20 with exact replay-free resumption; production runner and commercial readiness still unverified
